groups.label: Agriculture and rural development
groups.description: Farming, irrigation, fisheries, food processing, and schemes for rural jobs and incomes.

groups.label: Culture, media and sport
groups.description: Arts and heritage, public broadcasting, tourism, youth programmes and sport.

groups.label: Defence and security
groups.description: The army, navy and air force, their pensions and equipment, and the central police and border forces.

groups.label: Education, skills and research
groups.description: Schools, colleges and universities, job training, and scientific research.

groups.label: Energy, industry and the economy
groups.description: Power, oil and gas, coal, mining, heavy industry, trade and financial services.

groups.label: Environment and climate
groups.description: Forests and the environment, climate change, weather and ocean science, and renewable energy.

groups.label: Government and public administration
groups.description: Running the government itself: Parliament, the courts, tax collection, foreign affairs and central offices.

groups.label: Health and social protection
groups.description: Hospitals and health schemes, medicines, women and children, and support for disadvantaged and tribal communities.

groups.label: Interest and debt service
groups.description: Interest on money the government has already borrowed. It has to be paid in full every year.

groups.label: Grants to states and union territories
groups.description: Extra money the central government gives to states, and the budgets of union territories such as Ladakh and Chandigarh. This is separate from the states’ own share of taxes, which is set aside earlier.

groups.label: Transport, housing and infrastructure
groups.description: Railways, highways, ports, airports, telecom, housing and cities.
